title: Scarlet Eyes and the Stolen Dream — Part 3

series.summary: Kurapika confides his mission to avenge the slaughtered Kurta clan and recover their stolen scarlet eyes from the Phantom Troupe. Leorio reveals his own heartbreak over a friend lost to curable illness, before collapsing unconscious onto the stone floor.

segments.voiceover_text: Kurapika reveals his tragic past: the Kurta Clan's scarlet eyes. Five years ago, the Phantom Troupe slaughtered his entire family to sell their eyes, and he lives only for revenge.
Leorio fires back with his own heartbreaking secret: his best friend died of a curable illness simply because they were poor. He needs money to become a doctor and save lives.
Kurapika is humbled by Leorio's noble ambition and quietly apologizes, realizing his friend is anything but greedy.
Having bared his soul, Leorio's body gives out. He collapses face-down on the cold floor, completely unconscious as the runners leave him behind.
